ruling.reasoning:
This is a rider-side cancellation of an on-demand (RydeX) booking: acceptance at 21:30:00 and cancellation by the rider at 21:33:20, i.e. 3 min 20 s (200 s) after matching [F2]. NS-0 routes a rider cancellation to NS-4 [F2], and NS-4 provides that a cancellation made after the 3-minute mark makes the $6.61 cancellation fee payable [F2][F5]. The cancellation fee is an Ryde-published charge, so it is not an unpublished add-on under FARE-1 [F5].

The rider's reason — the driver was still far away — does not change the outcome. The GPS record shows the driver's closest approach was 2137 m and he never came within 200 m of the pickup [F1], and the chat has the driver promising "about 5 min, traffic" at 21:31 [F8]. But Ryde has no published rule allowing a free rider cancellation because the driver is late relative to the ETA (NS-8 is informational and cannot be applied; the case file carries no ETA field) [F1][F8]. Under NS-4 the rider's remedy for that grievance is a discretionary human appeal under NS-7, not an automatic waiver. The trace's NS-0 and NS-4 elements are settled (✓), and both allowed outcomes are no_action or escalate [F2].

No no-show branch is engaged: the driver never pressed "I'm Here" and no automatic arrival was recorded [F4], and driver_arrived_at is null [F3], so NS-1 does not apply and there is no basis to bill the fee as a passenger no-show; equally there is no account action against the driver under NS-2, because he never tapped the arrival button out of position [F4]. The driver's post-trip statement that he "was on his way" [F10] is a statement, not a system record, and is in any event consistent with the GPS [F1]. The traffic and weather facts (a 50–59 km/h band on Pasir Panjang Drive, no incidents, fair weather) [F11][F12][F13] are irrelevant to NS-4, which requires no justification from either side. The profiles on both sides (rider with no prior disputes, driver with one upheld no-show dispute) [F14][F15] cannot decide the case, and NS-2's disqualifying condition is absent, so RD-6-style account escalation does not attach on these facts [F4][F15].

Safety screen: I read every message — rider "How long will you be?" [F7], driver "About 5 min, traffic" [F8], the complete timestamped chat record [F9], the driver's written statement [F10], and the complaint [F2]. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the exchange is a routine timing query and reply [F7][F8][F10].

Amount: none. The $6.61 cancellation fee is validly charged under NS-4, and no refund calculation arises because there is no off-route segment and no over-collected add-on — the fare record shows $6.61 with no surge (1.0×) [F5][F6].
